newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish customs seize cannabis at ferry port.
newsitem.headline: Irish customs seize cannabis at ferry port.

text.p: Irish customs officers said on Monday they seized cannabis resin worth almost four million pounds ($6.4 million) hidden on a truck that arrived in the south-east port of Rosslare on a ferry from Cherbourg, France.
The driver, an Irishman in his late 20s, was arrested and was being questioned by police, they said.
"The drugs were concealed in the belly tank of a refrigeration unit on the truck which was carrying a cargo of lettuce from Spain," customs authorities said in a statement.
"The drugs, which have a street value of 3.84 million make this the biggest seizure at Rosslare harbour to date." ($1=.6228 Pound)
